newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Suburban started a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Suburban started a buy.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it started coverage of Suburban Lodges of America Inc on Friday with a buy rating.

-- Analyst Christopher Marinac gave the stock a $30 a share target, citing its management and strong product in a nascent segent of the hotel real estate industry. The company offers extended-stay lodging at an economy price point.
-- Suburban shares rose 7/16 to 24-1/2 in early exchange trading.
